points.text: any four from:
1 geographical isolation / barrier qualified ;
2 no, interbreeding / gene flow (between European and American populations) ;

4 random / different, mutations ;

any three from:
1 not possible / difficult, to come to a (reliable) conclusion ;
2 small difference in height / heights are similar (so natural selection not more important than genetic drift) ;
3 taller / lighter, bison could be an advantage in reaching higher vegetation (so natural selection may be important) ;

1 obtain / use, blood / cells / tissue / DNA ;
